slices.name: Terraform foundation: DynamoDB, S3, IAM
slices.description: Provision the core AWS infrastructure: 5 DynamoDB tables (tenants, quoteRequests, orders, sessions, magicLinks), 3 S3 buckets (assets, admin, sitemaps), IAM roles for each Lambda with least-privilege policies, and SSM parameter store entries for config.

slices.name: Shared types package
slices.description: Define all TypeScript interfaces, type guards, enums, and validation functions used across the monorepo: Tenant, Product, MarketDate, QuoteRequest, Session, MagicLink, ApiResponse envelope, EventType, and all input validators.

slices.name: DB client + tenant helpers
slices.description: Implement the DynamoDB client wrapper and tenant data access functions: getTenantBySlug, getTenantByEmail, updateTenant, getTenantsByCity, scanAllTenants. Uses DocumentClient with typed inputs/outputs.

slices.name: Renderer Lambda: SSR vendor page
slices.description: Server-side render vendor pages at /{slug}. Reads tenant from DynamoDB, generates complete HTML with inline CSS, SEO metadata (title, description, OG tags, canonical), JSON-LD (LocalBusiness + Product schemas), responsive layout with all sections (nav, hero, story, products, calendar, quote form, more-in-city, footer), and mobile bottom nav. Includes GET /api/vendors/{slug} JSON endpoint.

slices.name: Quote request handler + DB helpers
slices.description: Handle quote request submissions: validate input, verify vendor exists, create DynamoDB record, send email notification to vendor via SES. Includes the quoteRequests DB functions (create, query by vendor, mark as read) and the API Lambda internal router scaffold.

slices.name: Sitemap Lambda
slices.description: Generate XML sitemaps on a daily schedule. Scans all tenants, produces sitemap-index.xml, sitemap-vendors.xml, and sitemap-cities.xml, writes to sitemaps S3 bucket.

slices.name: Cache invalidator Lambda
slices.description: Invalidate CloudFront cached paths when vendor data changes. Receives a list of paths, creates a CloudFront invalidation batch. Invoked programmatically by the API Lambda after writes.

slices.name: Terraform compute: API Gateway + CloudFront + Lambda deploy
slices.description: Provision the compute and networking layer: API Gateway HTTP API with all route definitions and CORS, CloudFront distribution with 5 origins and cache behaviours, Lambda function deployments for renderer, API, sitemap, and cache invalidator, EventBridge schedule for sitemap.

slices.name: Seed data script: Oscar (Sweet Sin)
slices.description: Create an idempotent seed script that inserts Oscar's vendor data (Sweet Sin, Adelaide, AU) into the tenants table. Includes products, market dates, photos, categories, and social links for a realistic page render.

slices.name: Staging deploy + smoke test
slices.description: Deploy all V1 components to staging environment. Run smoke tests verifying: vendor page renders at /{slug}, quote form submission works, email notification is delivered, sitemap is generated, 404 for unknown slugs, CloudFront caching works.

slices.name: Auth Lambda: magic link + session + logout
slices.description: Handle magic link authentication flow. POST /api/auth/request: look up tenant by email, generate token, store in magicLinks table, send email via SES. GET /api/auth/verify: validate token, create session, set cookie, redirect. POST /api/auth/logout: delete session, clear cookie. Includes rate limiting (3/hr/email).

slices.name: Session + magic link DB helpers
slices.description: Implement DynamoDB data access functions for sessions and magic links: createSession, getSession, deleteSession, createMagicLink, getAndDeleteMagicLink. All functions handle TTL-based expiry.

slices.name: withAuth middleware
slices.description: Implement the withAuth higher-order function that wraps API Lambda handlers. Extracts dmercato_session cookie, validates session via GetSession, attaches vendorSlug to event, returns 401 if invalid. Does not perform authorization (slug matching is handler responsibility).

slices.name: Vendor update handler
slices.description: PUT /api/vendors/{slug} handler. Validates input, checks authorization (session slug matches URL slug), updates tenant in DynamoDB, triggers cache invalidation for /{slug} and /sitemap*. Only whitelisted fields are updatable.

slices.name: Photo upload handler
slices.description: POST /api/vendors/{slug}/photos/upload-url handler. Validates content type, generates presigned S3 PUT URL with size constraints (10MB max, 5-min expiry), returns the upload URL and asset key. Vendor uploads directly to S3.

slices.name: Quote requests management handlers
slices.description: GET /api/quote-requests/{slug} (paginated list, sorted newest first) and PUT /api/quote-requests/{slug}/{requestId} (mark as read). Both require auth and authorization (vendor can only see their own requests).

slices.name: Admin SPA scaffold: React + Vite + routing + auth flow
slices.description: Set up the admin SPA with React, Vite, React Router. Routes: /admin/login, /admin/, /admin/profile, /admin/calendar, /admin/quotes. Auth flow: login form sends email, check-your-email screen, session detection, logout. Protected route wrapper redirects to login if no session.

slices.name: Admin SPA: profile editing page
slices.description: Build the profile editing page in the admin SPA. Loads vendor data, editable form fields (name, tagline, story, city, country, categories, social links), product management (add/edit/delete/reorder), photo upload zones (primary + gallery), save button with validation feedback.

slices.name: Admin SPA: market calendar page
slices.description: Build the market calendar page in the admin SPA. Lists market dates sorted chronologically, past dates collapsed, next upcoming date highlighted. Add/edit/delete market dates with date picker. Saves via PUT /api/vendors/{slug} with updated marketDates array.

slices.name: Admin SPA: quote requests page
slices.description: Build the quote requests page in the admin SPA. Paginated list sorted newest first, unread requests visually distinct, click to expand details, expanding marks as read. Unread count in sidebar nav. Pagination controls.

slices.name: Admin SPA deploy: S3 + CloudFront behaviour
slices.description: Deploy the admin SPA build to the admin S3 bucket. Update CloudFront with /admin/* behaviour pointing to admin S3 origin. Configure index.html fallback for client-side routing.

slices.name: Production deploy + full validation
slices.description: Deploy all V2 components to production. Validate end-to-end: magic link login flow, profile editing, photo upload, market date management, quote request list, read/unread toggling, logout. Verify cache invalidation works after edits.
